svg.text: B-17 P7 — the gizmo look, proposal 2/2 (design §2.6) · pick cursor + banner · rotate ring · screen text
Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
lean: the OS crosshair cursor over the map while a pick is pending (one call, both views); the banner on a dark strip with a real Cancel button; the rejection on a backdrop
no backdrop, a small orange +, '[Cancel]' as text
pick a unit, not a graphic
banner = the existing ImGui strip style (P4) — same in both views
⑤ Rotate — one unit, a group about its centre, a group each about its own centre
lean: keep the ring and the live label; add the swept wedge from the start angle and a knob; label '+35°' on a backdrop; 'each' mode draws a small arc on every unit
a thin yellow ring + ray; 'group -46deg', no backdrop
the ring lies on the ground under the group
⑥ Text on the map — hints, labels, the degrees readout
lean: ONE backdrop for every screen-space gizmo text (black 60 %, 3 px radius) in the shared text drawer; load the font with '·', '°', '—', '×'; the tick button says 'Done'
thin text straight on the ground; font loaded ASCII-only
click: add point ? Enter / tick: finish ? Esc
'?' where '·' should be (to confirm on the real app)
click: add point · Enter / Done: finish (3+) · Esc: cancel
Roboto at 13 px, readable on any ground
today: a tick box with no word
Roboto has no ✓, so the hint cannot say ✓;
a button labelled 'Done' says the same in
